title: Two-sided inverse to degreewise currying
statement: For every site C with topology J, sheaf R of commutative rings in universe max u v, cochain complexes K,L,M of R-modules, and integer n, there exists one reverse morphism b from homComplex (Tot(K tensor L)) M in degree n to homComplex K (homComplex L M) in degree n such that, for every forward morphism a satisfying the localized pure-tensor currying equation of lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise (expanded verbatim in the Lean statement), a followed by b and b followed by a are identity morphisms. No existence of a forward map is asserted; b is constructed independently of a.

proof.text: For a localized map from a total tensor term to M restrict to every K^p tensor L^q summand. Curry the two inputs by the localized tensor-Hom adjunction, then assemble the q and p components using the inner and outer Hom product universal properties. Compatibility with restriction gives a reverse sheaf morphism b. This reverse construction is independent of a forward map; keep the same b for every forward map satisfying the equation.

Project a followed by b to p and q and evaluate at x and y. The assumed forward evaluation equation and the inverse laws of tensor-Hom currying give the identity; product extensionality finishes this composite.

Project b followed by a to each total degree and restrict to every summand. Check on pure tensors before sheafification by the same currying inverse laws. The sheafification adjunction and coproduct/product universal properties give the other identity.

theorem homTensorDegreewise_inverse (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∃ b : (homComplex (R := R)
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M).X n ⟶
      (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).X n,
      ∀ a, HomTensorDegreewiseEquation R K L M n a → a ≫ b = 𝟙 _ ∧ b ≫ a = 𝟙 _
